stories.title: Erling Haaland's "Nice" selfie at an empty Old Trafford
stories.summary: Erling Haaland scored the winner as 10-man Manchester City beat Manchester United at Old Trafford, then posted a selfie in the emptied stadium captioned "Nice". It got 432K likes, the most-liked post on X that day. Hours later, the referees' body Pro Ref acknowledged "an error of judgement" in allowing his goal.
